name: nodemon

anyOf.description: The filename you pass to nodemon

colours.description: set to false to disable color output

cwd.description: change into <dir> before running the script

delay.description: debounce restart for a number of milliseconds

exec.description: execute script with "app", ie. -x "python -v".  May use variables.

execMap.description: The global config file is useful for setting up default executables

ignore.description: Ignore directory or file.  One entry per ignored value.  Wildcards are allowed.

items.description: Path or pattern of file or directory to ignore.  Can also use regular expressions wrapped in an object with a single property named "re".

legacyWatch.description: use polling to watch for changes (typically needed when watching over a network/Docker)

nodeArgs.description: arguments to pass to node if exec is "node"

pollingInterval.description: combined with legacyWatch, milliseconds to poll for (default 100)

quiet.description: minimise nodemon messages to start/stop only

runOnChangeOnly.description: execute script on change only, not startup

signal.description: use specified kill signal instead of default (ex. SIGTERM)

spawn.description: force nodemon to use spawn (over fork) [node only]

stdin.description: set to false to have nodemon pass stdin directly to child process

verbose.description: show detail on what is causing restarts

watch.description: Watch directory or file.  One entry per watched value.  Wildcards are allowed.

items.description: Path or pattern of file or directory to watch.  Can also use regular expressions wrapped in an object with a single property named "re".

description:
We’re running the application with nodemon using colored output enabled and changing into the `./src` directory before launch. Restarts are debounced by 250 milliseconds and the script is started with the plain `node` executable. For convenience the exec‑map defines that `.js` files run with `node`, `.ts` with `ts-node`, and `.py` with `python3`. Crashes should terminate nodemon ( `exitcrash` is true), and we watch for changes to files with the extensions `js,ts,json`. The watch list includes the `src` folder, any JavaScript file under `src/**/*.js`, and any JSON file matching the regular expression `config/.*\.json$`. Files and directories to ignore are `node_modules`, any path matching the regex `^\.git/`, and any `*.log` file. Additionally the root‑level paths `.git` and `dist` are excluded from monitoring. Because we’re operating in an environment where file events are unreliable, legacy watch mode is turned on and polling is set to 200 ms. Node is started with the argument `--inspect=9229`.  

All other flags are left at their defaults except where noted: a full debug dump is off, update notifications are allowed, the process is not forced into spawn mode, stdin is forwarded, and verbose output is enabled so we can see detailed restart reasons. We are not running in quiet mode, nor are we limiting execution to changes only, and the termination signal used on restart is `SIGTERM`.
